data.summary: Senior Business Analyst with 6+ years delivering AI-augmented analysis, data-backed client outcomes, and BRDs that engineering ships from without a PM layer across BFSI, fintech, HRMS, and enterprise automation. I use ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor as daily workflow tools, not experiments. I have managed BA teams end-to-end, run QBRs with senior finance and operations stakeholders, and owned the full requirement-to-UAT lifecycle across 135+ automation programs. I bring this same combination of AI-augmented speed and structured requirements ownership to whichever environment I'm working in, translating complex business problems into solutions engineering can build from directly.

SUMMARY
Senior Business Analyst with 6+ years delivering AI-augmented analysis, data-backed client outcomes, and BRDs that engineering ships from without a PM layer across BFSI, fintech, HRMS, and enterprise automation. I use ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor as daily workflow tools, not experiments. I have managed BA teams end-to-end, run QBRs with senior finance and operations stakeholders, and owned the full requirement-to-UAT lifecycle across 135+ automation programs. I bring this same combination of AI-augmented speed and structured requirements ownership to whichever environment I'm working in, translating complex business problems into solutions engineering can build from directly.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Requirements Engineering (BRD/FRD/RTM) | AI-Augmented Workflow Design | SQL & Advanced Data Analysis | Cognos Analytics | Tableau | Power BI | Team Leadership & BA Management | Stakeholder Management | QBR Delivery | UAT Ownership | RCA Structuring | Agile/Scrum | NLP | IDP | OCR | Jira | Confluence | Visio | OutSystems | SDLC | Product Roadmap | User Stories
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Requirements & BA: BRD, FRD, RTM, User Stories, Use Cases, Data Lineage, Process Mapping, Stakeholder Management, UAT, Change Request Management AI & GenAI: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Copilot – daily workflow; Prompt Engineering, AI Prompt Design, NLP, IDP (Intelligent Document Processing), OCR, LLM integration Data & Visualization: SQL (complex joins, window functions, aggregations, query optimisation), IBM Cognos Analytics, Tableau, Power BI, Python, Pandas Automation & RPA: Automation Anywhere A360, UiPath, Power Automate, GenAI-powered Automation Agile & Project: Scrum, Scrum Master, SAFe Agile, Sprint Planning, Backlog Management, Risk Governance, SDLC, Process Mining Low-Code / No-Code: OutSystems, Power Automate, RPA Platforms Tools: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Visio, ERP Systems, CRM Systems Mainframe: CICS, Mainframe-RPA Integration, Screen Scraping for Mainframe UI Automation
CERTIFICATIONS & COURSES
Automation Anywhere (RPA) · UiPath · OutSystems · Power BI Microsoft · Tableau · Soroco · Business Analyst Professional · GenAI & Prompt Engineering · LLM & AI Applications
raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
HireRight Bangalore, India Senior Business System Analyst – Intelligent Automation & AI Delivery
Jun 2025 – Present
Built and maintain recurring AI-powered workflows using Claude, ChatGPT, and Copilot for QBR narrative drafting, RCA structuring, BRD first-pass generation, and stakeholder communication reducing documentation effort by 50% and establishing AI augmentation as the team baseline, not an exception; all workflows documented so any team member can replicate independently.
Authored end-to-end BRD for the Uber Widescreen Plus program ($200K+) covering SSN, DOB, county, and watchlist screening automation logic, validation rules, exception handling, and data transformation workflows—specific enough that engineering built and shipped without a PM translation layer, delivering 85% effort reduction and 70% accuracy improvement at scale.
Wrote BRD and solution design for SPI Waiver Automation: NLP-based document validation rule logic, IDP/OCR reconciliation pipeline, and exception handling flows—owned delivery from BRD through UAT sign-off, reducing manual effort by 75% and improving accuracy by 65%.
Maintained live automation backlog across 4 programs—each item prioritised with business justification, engineering effort estimate, and expected impact on operational throughput; identified recurring manual tasks and converted them into formal BRD candidates on a weekly triage cycle.
Built 10+ Cognos and Power BI dashboards using SQL for tracking automation ROI, SLA compliance, KPI trends, and operational metrics—each scoped to answer a specific decision question for a defined leadership audience; presented dashboard insights proactively at senior leadership reviews.
Led enterprise bot migration from Automation Anywhere to Power Automate (Clearing House) with zero downtime— authored the migration BRD, defined rollback logic, and reduced ongoing maintenance effort by 40%.
Conducted 25+ discovery workshops with 15+ stakeholders across business and consulting teams; maintained RTM and data lineage documentation throughout SDLC with structured change request governance and scope enforcement. ● Serving as Scrum Master for a 6-member Agile team driving 20+ sprints, backlog prioritisation, risk governance, and on- time delivery.
Happiest Minds Technologies Bangalore, India Software Engineer (Business Analyst & Product Lead)
Mar 2022 – May 2025
Managed and developed a team of BAs across a 135+ bot automation program—defined output quality standards for BRDs, RCA documents, and dashboard deliverables; ran structured 1:1s, performance conversations, and SQL and tooling upskilling for each team member.
Drove requirements engineering for HRMS digital transformation across 3 business verticals—authored BRDs, FRDs, and user stories for 12+ product features; identified recurring customisation patterns across client requests and escalated 4 to the product roadmap rather than maintaining them as custom builds.
Scaled automation coverage to 135+ bots across IT support, finance, and BFSI—reducing operational overhead by 60% and enabling straight-through processing for 10,000+ monthly transactions.
● Defined process and solution design for 135+ automation use cases—created RTMs, data flow diagrams, and data
lineage maps in Visio; maintained a structured automation backlog with business justification and impact estimates per item.
Led Mainframe (CICS) automation for a BFSI client—integrated RPA bots with CICS screens to automate core banking workflows, reducing manual processing time by 60% and improving data accuracy.
Built and maintained enterprise mobile apps and web portals using OutSystems for NGO healthcare initiatives, supporting 5,000+ active users. Used Cognos Analytics for project health tracking and dashboarding.
Developed Tableau and Cognos dashboards surfacing actionable insights from large-scale datasets for senior leadership decisions.
Empulse Global Bangalore, India RPA Analyst
Sept 2021 – Feb 2022
Deployed 5+ industrial and financial process automations using Automation Anywhere A360 covering invoice processing, PO validation, and Order to Cash (O2C) workflows, reducing manual effort by 50% across finance operations.
Conducted requirements gathering and AS-IS process mapping for each automation use case, translating business rules into RPA solution designs with supporting documentation.
